items.title: Piranguinho (MG) Transport & vehicles procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #05
items.en_title: Piranguinho (MG) Transport & vehicles procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #05
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Piranguinho (MG) is procuring vehicles, transport or related equipment and services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 348,112.38; proposals close Nov 25, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
